description: This Java source file defines the IntegrationModulesLoader class, which loads and processes JSON configuration files to instantiate and populate IntegrationModule objects with various configuration details, including modules, types, custom flags, and regional configurations.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading integration modules from a JSON configuration file and parsing it into a list of IntegrationModule objects.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the specified path, parses its contents, and returns a list of loaded IntegrationModule instances.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationModule object from a map representing JSON data, setting properties such as module, code, image, type, customModule, details, configuration, regions, and associated configurations.
